description: Every public protective-action message must trace to a PAD/PAR or other named authority decision with timestamp.
required_evidence: authority decision log and timestamp

description: EAS/WEA/SNB/press templates must be current, hashed, and loaded before message release.
required_evidence: template revision, hash, load log

description: Public URLs embedded in emergency messages must be live at release time.
required_evidence: URL test log/screenshot/hash at release time

description: KI instruction must be consistent across channels and must not combine take-KI and do-not-take-KI language absent a new authority decision.
required_evidence: KI authority decision and cross-channel diff

description: Affected jurisdictions and municipalities must be named or correctly scoped; missing Chester/equivalent omission is a P0 failure.
required_evidence: jurisdiction inclusion checklist

description: Farmer/producer messages must not conflict with evacuation, shelter, KI, or ingestion-pathway controls.
required_evidence: producer-message review and ingestion-control decision log

description: School dismissal or movement instructions must be coordinated with EMA during escalating plant conditions.
required_evidence: school decision log, EMA consultation, training roster

description: Message release order must be timestamped across PAD/PAR, EAS, WEA/IPAWS, SNB, press, county, and JIC channels.
required_evidence: channel timestamp ledger

description: Public warning packet must include language and accessibility review or be capped at hold/no-upgrade.
required_evidence: language/accessibility signoff and fallback channel

description: Message packet must pass public-safe redaction review before export.
required_evidence: redaction class, sensitive annex routing, public-safe summary

description: Prior defect closure requires CAP/retest/verifier evidence; a revised template alone is not enough.
required_evidence: CAP assignment, retest result, independent verifier

description: Future exercise notice cannot be described as completed, passed, or closed.
required_evidence: official post-exercise AAR/IP or preliminary finding record

description: Daily reactor power status is not emergency-preparedness readiness evidence.
required_evidence: local EP evidence packet; reactor status may only contextualize operating state

description: EN58200 public event text cannot close EOF power-loss corrective action.
required_evidence: restoration, root cause, retest, EP04 reconciliation, CAP closure, verifier

description: A clean Ohio/Columbiana prior AAR baseline cannot offset PA/WV open or carryforward public-information blockers.
required_evidence: jurisdiction-specific current closure evidence

description: Drill/exercise messages must be clearly labeled as exercise where appropriate, preventing accidental public-action ambiguity.
required_evidence: exercise message label and controller/evaluator log

description: Public warning packet must include rumor/correction path; absence caps to hold/no-upgrade.
required_evidence: rumor log, correction authority, publication channel

description: PIO/JIC leadership review must occur before release unless emergency bypass is logged and later adjudicated.
required_evidence: reviewer role, time, signoff, bypass justification if any

description: Public summaries cannot say ready/green/passed/closed based on public context, future schedule, or fixture data.
required_evidence: adjudicated local packet and public claim gate

description: Counterevidence must reopen a row rather than being treated as a failed packet import.
required_evidence: counterevidence source, affected row, reopen owner
